description: This file defines various activation function modules for the PyTorch C++ API, including classes for ELU, SELU, Hardshrink, Hardtanh, LeakyReLU, LogSigmoid, Softmax, Softmin, LogSoftmax, Softmax2d, PReLU, ReLU, ReLU6, RReLU, CELU, GLU, GELU, SiLU, Mish, Sigmoid, Softplus, Softshrink, Softsign, Tanh, Tanhshrink, Threshold, and MultiheadAttention. It includes class declarations, options, and method signatures for these modules, with documentation and example usage.
